DocuOrgAppl installer package

File:
- DocuOrgAppl-installer.apk

How to share on Google Drive:
1. Upload DocuOrgAppl-installer.apk to Google Drive.
2. Share the link with anyone who needs the app.

How to install on Android:
1. Download the APK from Google Drive on the phone.
2. Open the downloaded file.
3. Allow installs from unknown sources if prompted.
4. Tap Install.

Notes:
- This APK is currently built from the debug variant.
- If you want a Play Store-style release APK, I can prepare a signed release build next.
